'''Ruiyun''' is an NPC in {{location|Jinzhou}}.

==Dialogue==
===Daytime===
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Ruiyun:''' Ugh. All this walking back and forth in the city is such a drag. I'm just wasting my life at this point.
:'''Ruiyun:''' And there's my dad, nagging about how the frontline's not the place for a girl like me.
:'''Ruiyun:''' What does he know?! Just look at [[Yuzan]], she's doing pretty well, isn't she? She even got herself a promotion. I bet I can do it too!
:'''Ruiyun:''' *sigh* When is this one heck of a boring job ever going to end...?
{{Dialogue End}}
